capabilities: sync Trakt.tv watched history into a bulleted list in a note
generate date-specific backlinks for watched shows and movies
import watch history and ratings from a Trakt ZIP data export
connect to the Trakt API via OAuth with a developer app
disambiguation: Not a vault or file syncing tool; it writes Trakt.tv watch data into a single note file.
extras: Free Trakt accounts cannot use third-party OAuth, so they must use the manual ZIP export path; API/OAuth sync requires Trakt VIP or a registered developer application.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull your Trakt.tv viewing history and ratings into your notes.

relations.evidence: This project syncs your Trakt checkins to a file in Obsidian

requires.name: Trakt developer app Client ID and Secret

summary: Trakt.tv integration that syncs your watch history and ratings into a vault note with date-specific backlinks.
